lines: Kaura barged into Cell H, accompanied by lower-ranking guards.
The female inmates shuddered at the unusually menacing look of their warden.
「What the hell're you talking about, Warden?」
Another prisoner asked a more little calmly, but
「Silence! Search every part of the cell!」
Kaura ordered the guards, ostentatiously brandishing her demonic sword, which absorbed people's souls.
The troll guards began a flurried search of the inside of the cell.
Kaura put a call in on her radio, in an irritated tone.
「Listen up. Track down Cowtits! Leave no stone unturned!」
「Don't put a scratch on her. She's my plaything, and some valuable merchandise.」
However, no report that Kirara had been found came back from her subordinates at all.
She wasn't in the canteen, the exercise yard, the shower room, the rec room, or any other cell.
Furthermore, it emerged that Shikanosuke, who had been imprisoned before Kirara, had disappeared as well.
「W-Warden... Cowtits is nowhere to be found!」
「Tch. Not here either?! Oi, Yukikaze! Where's Cowtits? Come out and tell me what you know!」
「Um...... Looks like Yukikaze's not here either.」
Perhaps not believing that report from a lower-ranking guard, Kaura searched around the inside of the cell herself, her eyes growing bloodshot.
However, Yukikaze/Lilim, who was the boss of Cell H, had indeed disappeared.
「All of you! What's the meaning of this?!」

「The meaning?!」
「We don't really get it either...... Right?」
Kaura casually plunged her demonic sword into the thigh of a nearby inmate.
「Yukikaze, Kirara and Shikanosuke are together, aren't they?! Where'd they go?!」
「If you don't wanna get your soul eaten by my demonic sword, spill everything right now!」
「I-I dunno! H-Her toothbrush lit up, and soon as that happened, this blue lady suddenly appeared!」
「Y-You might not believe it, but a blue woman came out o' nowhere, then disappeared, taking the Boss and her friends with her!」
The woman who had had her thigh stabbed by the demonic sword answered frantically, with a face that looked like she was about to die at any moment.
「We don't get what happened at all either!」
「A blue woman appeared, and before we knew what was what, the next moment, th-they'd vanished! It's the truth!」
The other women also pleaded unanimously.
Kaura clicked her tongue, and pulled her demonic sword out of the female prisoner.
It was a short time before that.
Tekkain Kaworu was interrogating Sakura, who had been captured by her chains.
Kaworu wrapped her entire body around with chains, and squeezed it tightly.
「Igawa Sakura, this was significant enough for you to show your face. This isn't all there is to it, correct?」
「To begin with, how did you intend to escape from prison?」
「Are there others who have broken in, or something to that effect? Well?」
「It would appear you'd like to suffer more.」
As the little sister of the Almighty Taimanin, Sakura had been captured by enemies and subjected to all manner of tortures many times before, but
She still seemed to be struggling with Kaworu's chains, which supposedly became sturdier and heavier in proportion to the weight of the captured person's sins.
「Uguuuhh...... I guess these...... have gotten a little tight...... guguuuh...」
「I see. Then, would you two like to be bound in chains in Onee-chan's stead?」
「Well then, it's time for these, right?」
Yuffie and Sophie took out toothbrushes.
She knew the characters of the twin oni, who seemed to have fun with everything, but that was still outside her expectations.
「Um-hmm. We were told to use these if the Useless Onee-chan was in a pinch.」
「O-Onee-chan would've liked you to use them a little sooner, you know......? Kukuku.」
The toothbrushes that the oni twins had raised lit up.
A pure-white flash of light spread out.
Wary of some kind of attack, Kaworu reflexively put herself on guard.
The next moment, four figures appeared in front of her dazzled eyes.
They were Onisaki Kirara, Lilim, Shikanosuke, and―――
We had carried out a leap into a darkened room.
It was a room gloomier and more confined than Cell H, probably used for torture.
As evidence of that, Sakura-sensei was tied up on the floor.
She looked to be in pain, with chains coiled all around her, but the eyes that looked at us were the same as usual, saying 「Whoops, sorry!」
The one restraining Sakura-sensei that way was the head of Amidahara Prison, Tekkain Kaworu.
As far as I was concerned, ever since I was a child, she had been a scary, beautiful older sister-type who was on a different level from me.
Her face was exactly the same as it was back then. No, even more scary and beautiful.
However, it was, understandably, wearing a look of surprise due to us having appeared all of a sudden.
Behind Sakura-sensei and Kaworu, the oni twins who were our targets were holding up their toothbrushes.
It seemed like it was not Sakura-sensei, but those twins who had pressed the switches on them.
It was unclear what the situation was, but for some reason they both looked to be having fun.
Anyway, I (in the form of Kirara-senpai), Shikanosuke, Lilim (who came along while we were at it) and Rinko-senpai (the star player here) had accomplished our leap into the enemy stronghold.
My final card to play in the Amidahara Prison infiltration plan——That was Rinko-senpai.
In other words, it was a surprise attack and breakout which utilized a “spacial leap” through her Void Escape Arts.
Of course, even if it was Rinko-senpai, that didn't mean that she could do a spacial leap to any place she liked at any time.
There were limits to its application, and she normally only performed leaps that were within her field of vision.
That was because, otherwise, there was the possibility of a major catastrophe, where the point you leapt to turned out to be inside a wall.
Because of that, what I had asked the engineering department to develop was a special GPS device embedded in a toothbrush.
It was devised so that the distance and angle of the GPS device could be perceived by Rinko-senpai.
By using that, it made it possible to leap to places outside her range of vision freely and accurately, to some extent.
Rinko-senpai engaged in training on a daily basis, but at the present time, zero-visibility spacial leaps were feasible within a range of 400 metres.
To get within those 400 metres, it had been necessary to infiltrate the prison with the toothbrushes.
However, Kaworu's reactions had been swift.
Perhaps having instantly judged the situation, she produced two more chains, and captured Yuffie and Sophie with them.
The twin oni screamed in unison, but their faces still looked like they were enjoying themselves.
「I can't let you get away that easily!」
「Owowow......... Hey! You think you can win against this many people by yourself?!」
「You're better off surrendering here! Also, this hurts! Your chains are tight!!」
Sakura, who had been wrapped up like a caterpillar in Kaworu's chains, urged her to surrender.
She was supposed to be the most powerful person here, surpassing even Rinko-senpai, who was undoubtedly the strongest of us, but
It looked like even she couldn't move once she was captured by Kaworu's Chain Escape Arts.
「That's right! That's right! Release Sakura-sensei, and Yuffie and Sophie!」
「Fufu...... You may all be present and correct, but you're also all prisoners who have had their abilities sealed off, aren't you?」
「Kuuuh～～, if it weren't for that seal......!」
「......Then I would strike you down with a lightning storm from hell～～!」
One after the other, Lilim and Shikanosuke both stuck out their chests and boldly declared that they were completely useless.
Kaworu jingled her chains, as she alertly watched me and Rinko-senpai.
It wasn't like my regeneration ability had been sealed off, but could I take her on empty-handed?
I had become more capable thanks to my battle training with Library, but probably not enough to be able to fight against Kaworu unarmed.
She had been a high-ranking member of the Nisha family, but her strength was also unparalleled among the Fuuma clan, and the name of “Kaworu of the Steel Chains” was famous among all the Taimanin.
「And so, the only one who can fight me is you, the, what was it...... “Slasher Taimanin”, yes?」
「Indeed. It is a great pleasure for me to be able to fight to the death with Kaworu of the Steel Chains.」
Rinko-senpai quietly prepared to draw Ishikiri Kanemitsu.
